sentences.en: For people in parts of the world with seasons — especially cold ones — winter might seem like a time to rest and to take a break from garden work.
sentences.zh: 对于世界上有季节——特别是寒季——的人来说,冬天似乎是一个休息和休息的时机。

sentences.en: But it is not, says Associated Press gardening expert Jessica Damiano.
sentences.zh: 美联社的园艺专家杰西卡·达米诺(Jessica Damiano)说,但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Autumn and winter are the best times to attend to your garden’s needs and prepare for the next growing season.
sentences.zh: 秋冬是满足花园需求、为下一个生长季节做准备的最佳时机。

sentences.en: There is much to do for both outdoor and indoor plants.
sentences.zh: 户外植物和户外植物都需要做很多工作。

sentences.en: Outdoor care For people who want flowers like tulips in the early spring plant the bulbs that produce them if your soil is not frozen.
sentences.zh: 户外护理 对于那些想要花 喜欢郁金香 在早期春天 植物的灯泡 生产 如果你的土壤不冻。

sentences.en: If you can still dig, plant tulips, daffodils and other bulbs.
sentences.zh: 如果你还能挖, 植物郁金香,水仙和其他灯泡。

sentences.en: Cover them with about eight centimeters of mulch , leaves or dried grass.
sentences.zh: 覆盖他们大约八厘米的沼泽、叶子或干草。

sentences.en: This will prevent freezing and melting temperatures from forcing them out of the ground over the winter.
sentences.zh: 这将防止寒冷和融化的温度迫使他们在冬季离开地面。

sentences.en: During winter months, even in more temperate areas, some plants need protection from the cold.
sentences.zh: 在冬季的几个月里,即使在较温带地区,一些植物也需要保护,以免受寒冷的影响。

sentences.en: These include some fruit trees, like citrus, dahlias and many plants that bloom in the spring.
sentences.zh: 这些树包括一些果树,比如柑橘、大莉亚和许多在春天开花的植物。

sentences.en: In winter conditions, a cloth cover called burlap can help limit the damaging effects of wind.
sentences.zh: 在冬季条件下,一个称为薄膜的布面可以帮助限制风的破坏性影响。

sentences.en: If snow builds up on the branches of evergreen trees and shrubs, remove it.
sentences.zh: 如果雪堆积在长青树和灌木的树枝上,就把它除掉。

sentences.en: The heavy weight can damage branches. Keep a record of plants you mean to move from one place to another in your garden.
sentences.zh: 重物会破坏树枝 记录你想要从一个地方搬到另一个地方的植物

sentences.en: The notes will guide you in early spring: a time that is best to move plants that bloom early in the season.
sentences.zh: 这些笔记将在初春指引你们: 最好在季节初开的植物上移动。

sentences.en: if you have extra seeds, consider trading them with gardening friends or at a gardening event.
sentences.zh: 如果你有多余的种子 考虑与园艺朋友或园艺活动进行交易

sentences.en: Store and organize seeds for the future in glass containers in cool places without light.
sentences.zh: 将种子储存在无光的凉爽地方,为未来组织种子。

sentences.en: Make sure to write down what they are and when they were collected.
sentences.zh: 一定要写下它们是什么 当它们被收集。

sentences.en: If insects or diseases were a problem during the growing season, use winter months to read about companion plants that can ease the problem in the coming year.
sentences.zh: 如果昆虫或疾病在生长季节是一个问题,就用冬季的月份来了解下一年可以缓解问题的伴生植物。

sentences.en: Indoor care The cold winter months also affect houseplants.
sentences.zh: 寒冬的月份也影响到家庭种植。

sentences.en: Bring houseplants near a south-facing or west-facing window to get the most sunlight possible.
sentences.zh: 在南面或西面的窗户附近 装上房子的植物 以获得尽可能高的阳光

sentences.en: Turn the houseplants about one fourth of a turn each time you water them.
sentences.zh: 你每次浇水时 都把家用植物转成四分之一左右

sentences.en: This will support more even growth. If you are buying poinsettias for the holidays, be sure to examine them for whiteflies before bringing them home.
sentences.zh: 这将支持更均衡的成长。 如果您在节假日购买薄荷糖, 请在带他们回家之前先检查它们是否为白蝇。

sentences.en: If you do not, you could bring home insects.
sentences.zh: 如果你不这样做,你可以把昆虫带回家。

sentences.en: If you plant Amaryllis bulbs indoors now, they will bloom during the coldest months of the winter.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在把阿玛丽丝灯泡放在室内, 它们会在冬天最寒冷的几个月里开花。

sentences.en: Plant them with their pointed ends reaching out of the potting soil and place them in a warm, sunny spot, watering them well.
sentences.zh: 用他们的尖尖的端端 植入肥沃的土壤 把他们放在温暖阳光的地方

sentences.en: After they bloom, keep them in a cooler place to extend the life of their flowers but keep them away from children and pets.
sentences.zh: 开花后 让他们待在更凉爽的地方 延长花的寿命 让他们远离孩子和宠物

sentences.en: Amaryllis bulbs are poisonous to eat. Remember the birds Damiano also advises to remember that non-migrating birds need food because most of their food sources are gone during the winter months.
sentences.zh: 阿马丽斯灯泡有毒。 记住达米诺鸟也建议记住,非迁徙鸟需要食物,因为大部分食物来源在冬季已经消失。

sentences.en: High quality birdseed and water can help.
sentences.zh: 高品质的鸟儿和水可以帮助。

sentences.en: These same birds will repay the effort by feeding on thousands of insects that threaten your garden during the warm growing season.
sentences.zh: 这些鸟儿会通过喂食成千上万的昆虫 来报答我们的努力 在温暖的生长季节,这些昆虫威胁到你的花园

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver. Jessica Damiano reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Caty Weaver,Jessica Damiano为美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Mario Ritter, Jr. adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 马里奥・里特,小。 改编它为VOA学习英语。
